legend.documented: Supported by a cited public device specification or device tree; not necessarily tested by DarwinG60.
legend.unknown: Requires further research or direct evidence.
legend.not_implemented: DarwinG60 has no implementation for this component.
legend.not_tested: An implementation or hypothesis exists but has not been validated on target hardware.

components.name: ARM64 CPU execution environment
components.evidence: The device family is based on a 64-bit Qualcomm Snapdragon 732G platform.

components.name: Adreno 618 graphics
components.evidence: Published Moto G60 specifications identify Adreno 618.

components.name: Display controller and panel initialization
components.evidence: Panel specifications alone do not describe the low-level initialization sequence.

components.name: Interrupt controller and timer configuration
components.evidence: Requires verified platform and firmware documentation.

components.name: Storage and partition access
components.evidence: Partition layout and storage controller details have not been independently validated for this project.

components.name: Touchscreen, audio, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, camera and sensors
components.evidence: No DarwinG60 drivers exist for these components.

components.name: Darwin/XNU kernel boot on Moto G60
components.evidence: No XNU port, platform bring-up, or hardware boot test exists in this repository.

safety_boundary: Research and host-side simulation only. No flashing, partition writes, bootloader changes, or device modification is part of this project.
